page.overview:
Who is Biggoron?

In , Biggoron is a gigantic Goron living on Death Mountain next to the Great Fairy Fountain. He is a skilled blade maker, and creator of the powerful Biggoron's Sword. To obtain it, Link must first complete the . During the , the Hero of Time brings Biggoron the Broken Goron's Sword to fix, but finds that Biggoron is unable to because of his irritated eyes. He then sends Link to get some Eye Drops, and gives him a Prescription. Eventually Link brings back the Eye Drops which clears Biggoron's eyes, which he reacts with delight. He then gives Link the Claim Check for the Biggoron's Sword, which takes three days to complete. Biggoron has a younger brother, Medigoron, who is also in the sword-making business, although the blades he produces are far inferior. Biggoron can also be seen during the game's ending credits dancing alongside regular-sized Gorons at Lon Lon Ranch.

In , Biggoron appears as the guard of the Snowhead Temple and is unrelated to the one in . He goes to Snowhead to investigate why spring has not yet come, but as his size bars him from entry he ends up simply sitting outside in the cold, his body blocking the path and the sheer force of his breath causing deadly wind gusts that prevent approach to the temple. Darmani III tried to investigate soon afterwards, only to get blown away by Biggoron's breath, leading to his death. To enter the temple, Link in his Goron form must play the "Goron Lullaby", putting Biggoron to sleep and causing him to roll off the cliff, thereby clearing the entrance. After defeating Goht and bringing spring to Snowhead, Biggoron can be found sitting in the gorge unaware of why he was there and what he had been doing.

In , Biggoron appears atop the peak of Goron Mountain. When the Temple of Seasons sank, the climate on the mountain became colder, causing Biggoron to catch a cold, similar to . Biggoron's ailment can be cured with the Lava Soup as part of the . In return, he gives Link the Goron Vase.

In a Linked Game of , a lone Goron on Rolling Ridge will provide Link with the Biggoron Secret. Telling the secret to Biggoron in allows him to forge the Biggoron's Sword.
